releaseNotes: KabirUI 5.2.0: easier search and app browsing, bigger wallpaper previews, and a new logo.

changes.title: Cleaner Quick Search
changes.detail: Search shows results only on a match, with no big no-apps card.

changes.title: Drawer puts installed apps first
changes.detail: Your apps come first, KabirUI shortcuts sit behind a compact group.

changes.title: Bigger wallpaper previews
changes.detail: Set wallpaper lives inside the preview, and KabirUI Market is now Settings - Features.

changes.title: 25 language choices and a new logo
changes.detail: Pick a language in setup or Settings, with the new glass KabirUI logo.

changes.title: Widget fixes on One UI 9
changes.detail: Fixes for third-party widgets that showed Couldn't add widget.
